purpose: Impact rules for paths that are created per unit/run and therefore can never be enumerated as nodes in .itd/IMPACT_GRAPH.json. Each rule is machine-checked by tests/verify_targeted_regression.py: a 'suites' rule must name suites that exist and that the mirror runs; a 'no-impact' rule is only valid while the generated map links NO path of that shape to any suite - the moment a suite starts reading such a path, the generator records it and the rule fails closed.

rules.why: Recorded live-model runs are replayed by the benchmark oracle; each run directory is generated per recording and cannot be a static node. The named suites are exactly the ones the generator attached to the already-recorded run directories.

Per-unit task contracts are created for every unit, so they cannot be static nodes. The advisory oracle is the only suite that reads the contracts directory; the DoD hook reads it at runtime and is covered through that suite.

Receipts, prompts and reports are evidence produced BY a run, never input to a suite: no suite reads this directory, which is why the generator records no node under it. The rule fails closed the moment that stops being true.
Per-round reviewer dispositions are run artefacts; no suite reads them. Checked against the generated map, not asserted.
Session memory files are written for humans and the next session; no suite reads an individual session file.
Hygiene records are produced by the hygiene tool; no suite reads an individual record.
